review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: complete main-to-5a010da feature diff and prior finding ledger
warm query and action worker lifecycle, diagnostics, failure, timeout, fallback, and no-replay behavior
public WeChat focus, open, draft, and send call path
deterministic package and root suites plus release preflight

decision.rationale: All prior findings are resolved. The exact implementation head has deterministic no-replay worker coverage, a successful 2461 ms public send, a separate 1272 ms Contacts-origin open path with a 58 ms warm Chats action, and green GitHub CI.

summary: The selector engine, semantic WeChat migration, safety checks, packaging, and release proof are complete. PRR-017 is resolved by warm action transport plus exact-head live and CI evidence; no open blocking finding remains. The public send and Contacts-origin transition were separate runs, and delivery read-back was not requested.

findings.title: Public send exceeds the three-second API contract
findings.observation: The prior representative public send measured 3116 ms. The exact-head remediation removes repeated action-process startup while preserving the original verified action script and no-replay safety boundary.
findings.trigger: Start WeChat outside Chats and execute the verified contact-open path used by public send_message.
findings.impact: Without remediation, consumers could observe the public convenience API above the approved 3000 ms representative performance target.

evidence.description: The direct backend starts a separate warm action worker and returns worker timeout or protocol failure without replay after dispatch.
Named tests cover worker success, protocol failure without subprocess replay, timeout without replay, worker script compilation, and original subprocess compatibility.
One authorized public send returned success true and submitted true in 2461 ms without retry.
A separate non-submit Contacts-origin open_contact returned in 1272 ms and measured the Chats AXPress at 58 ms with worker transport, no fallback, and verified preconditions.
GitHub Actions run 29217691709 passed every test, preflight, wheel, and distribution step against the exact head.

findings.remediation: Completed: reuse a prewarmed action process, preserve all app, snapshot, role, label, action, frame, and postcondition checks, and never replay after an uncertain dispatch.
findings.verification: Completed: deterministic suites, one authorized public send below 3000 ms, a real non-submit Contacts-to-Chats transition, and exact-head CI all passed.

required_actions.action: Implement a safety-equivalent bounded performance optimization and prove the public send path completes within 3000 ms.

risks.description: Local raw service logs can contain transient WeChat text.
risks.mitigation: Keep raw artifacts untracked and publish only bounded semantic evidence.

risks.description: Desktop UI state can change between resolution and action.
risks.mitigation: Retain exact identity, snapshot, frame, precondition, and target-title checks that fail closed.

risks.description: A worker timeout can leave a mutating action outcome unknown.
risks.mitigation: Never replay after dispatch; return timeout or failure for manual recovery.

risks.description: Live evidence is representative and does not characterize percentiles.
risks.mitigation: Retain bounded timing diagnostics and add repeated sampling if the threshold becomes an operational SLO.

risks.description: The transport changed internally for direct mode.
risks.mitigation: Public semantic APIs and helper behavior remain unchanged, with package and wheel compatibility tests.

risks.description: Default direct mode now owns two long-lived Accessibility workers.
risks.mitigation: The original subprocess remains available before dispatch, and the performance slice can be reverted as one commit.
